info.name: RouteAssign - Public API Test Collection
info.description: Public demo collection for the RouteAssign backend. Phase 1 creates test users and catalog/stock data; run it once against a disposable local database. Phase 2 creates orders and exercises assignment lifecycle/reassignment and read APIs. Configure baseUrl for your local server. Registration bodies use the collection variable testPassword, which is a demo-only value; change it for local testing if needed. This collection is provided as an example and has not been validated against every deployment or API configuration.

item.name: PHASE 1 - ONE-TIME DATA INITIALIZATION (run once only)
item.description: ONE-TIME SETUP: Creates users, resolves profile IDs, creates catalogue items, and initializes stock. Run once on a disposable development database.

item.name: 00 - Health check (starts a fresh run tag)

exec: pm.test("Application health is UP",function(){pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200);}); if (!pm.collectionVariables.get("runTag")) { pm.collectionVariables.set("runTag", String(Date.now())); }

item.name: PHASE 2 - ORDERS, REASSIGNMENT, AND API VERIFICATION
item.description: OPERATIONS: Places orders, exercises assignment lifecycle/reassignment, and verifies read APIs. Requires successful Phase 1.
